experiment: E38 DINO image branch + pure-EEG WCCN branch score-level fusion
motivation: E20-E35 DINO image route saturates at Test AUROC(S2 vs S1)=0.7327; E36 pure-EEG WCCN prototype reaches outer K16 AUROC 0.9981 with C 0.9998. Fuse the two branches at score level to keep the image route while meeting the open-set gates.

data.test_access: forbidden until a candidate is frozen and every Train gate passes

image.score: max_cosine and distance_ratio on task-specific WCCN-whitened class centroids

fusion.rule: per-sample rank-normalized fusion: each branch confidence is mapped to its own fit-fold known ECDF, then combined as w*image + (1-w)*pure_eeg
fusion.identity_rule: identity label from the branch with the larger fusion weight; ties resolved to pure_eeg
fusion.reason_for_ecdf: the two branches have different score scales; ECDF mapping is per-sample and uses only fit-fold known scores, so no Test or batch statistics are involved

nested_protocol.threshold_objective: maximize 100*C^0.40*U^0.25 subject to inner known acceptance >= 0.95; ties by C, U, AUROC, then configured order
nested_protocol.proxy_warning: C/U-only selection proxy; the adversarial A term is not part of this experiment

reporting.test_metrics: N/A: no public Test labels; only an unlabeled S1/S2 structural audit after freezing
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only pseudo-unknown and continuous file-block proxy; not cross-session evidence
